newsitem.title: USA: Mail bomb injures New Jersey woman.
newsitem.headline: Mail bomb injures New Jersey woman.

text.p: A woman was injured in a mail bomb explosion in this rural Cumberland County township Saturday that set her car on fire, Postal Inspector Bruce Chambers said.

He said the woman, whose identity was withheld, was taken to Cooper Medical Centre in Camden for treatment of burns and sharpnel wounds she suffered when a parcel she picked up from a postal box and opened in her car exploded.
Her injuries were described as not life threatening.
Chambers said postal inspectors were examining the debris from the mail bomb for clues on who sent it. It was not a very sophisticated device, he added.
